enabled.description: Opt-in switch. The plugin loads its definitions, opens its database and contributes a prompt fragment only when this is true.

packs.description: Content pack directory. Every *.json inside is one pack (packId + five primitives). Relative paths resolve against the plugin directory and may not escape it.

stateDirectory.description: Override for the plugin state directory. Defaults to <NATTER_STATE_DIR>/plugins/natter.feature.character.state-vitals.

stateId.description: Identifier of the single global character state row (design §7: one character, shared by every conversation).

fragmentOrder.description: Prompt fragment order. Kept late so state changes only invalidate the tail of the cached prefix (design §5.1).

includeDescriptions.description: Include the level's stored description next to the bucket tags. The text is written once per level entry, so the fragment stays stable while the level holds.

descriptionTimeoutMilliseconds.description: Budget for one description generation attempt. On timeout the template text is used and the turn is not blocked (design §6.2).

minAdvanceIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum wall-clock gap between persisted advances. 0 advances on every prompt read (a single row UPDATE).

maxStep.description: Upper clamp for the k*dt step fraction (design §3.1 point 2: MAX_STEP).

maxDeltaHours.description: Upper clamp for a single elapsed interval in hours, so off-line gaps cannot explode.

maxStepPerTickFraction.description: Upper clamp for the total change of one tick, as a fraction of the vital range (design §3.3 point 3).

maxAdvanceAttempts.description: Optimistic-concurrency retries when a competing writer wins the version compare-and-set.

maxFragmentCharacters.description: Self-imposed cap for the contributed fragment; descriptions are dropped before the host quota is reached.

maxPacks.description: Maximum number of content packs; exceeding it rejects at load time.

maxDefinitionsPerKind.description: Maximum vitals / assertedStates / derivedStates / triggers per pack.

maxEffectsPerPack.description: Maximum effects per pack, which bounds one tick of evaluation.
